about.title: Reedley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a collision on Manning Avenue, Dinuba Avenue, I Street, Reed Avenue, or anywhere else in Reedley changes everything overnight. While Reedley's most recent full-year data shows no traffic deaths recorded alongside 38 injury collisions and 53 people injured, fatal crashes still happen on Fresno County roads, and families are often left with funeral bills, lost income, and unanswered questions. California law gives certain surviving family members the right to pursue a wrongful death claim against the party responsible, separate from anything that happens in criminal court. We review what happened, explain your legal standing, and help you understand what losses may be recoverable. There's no cost to speak with us, and no obligation to move forward.

whyChoose.title: What Reedley Families Should Know About Wrongful Death Law

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in a wrongful death case to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible under certain circumstances. We can clarify who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Two Years
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim in California, though claims against a government entity — such as one involving a county road — carry a much shorter deadline. Acting early preserves evidence and options.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, as well as compensation for the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance. We can help identify what applies to your situation.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in Reedley under California law?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to bring the claim. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify under California's rules. We can review your family's circumstances and confirm who has standing.

items.question: How long do we have to file after losing a family member in a Reedley crash?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. If the crash involved a government-maintained road or a public entity, that deadline can be much shorter, so it's important not to wait to get information.

items.question: What if the crash happened on a busy Reedley street like Manning Avenue or Dinuba Avenue?
items.answer: High-traffic corridors like Manning Avenue, Dinuba Avenue, I Street, and Reed Avenue see a share of Reedley's reported collisions, and fatal crashes can still occur even in years with lower recorded death counts. We can look into how the crash happened and who may be responsible, regardless of which road it occurred on.

items.question: Do you charge anything to help us?
items.answer: No. Our service is free, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless your family recovers compensation.
